subject: Trading
title: Nick Leeson: The Rogue Trader
description: A quick win: understand Nick Leeson: The Rogue Trader.

hook.text: One trader destroyed a 233-year-old bank. Nick Leeson's hidden losses brought down Barings Bank in 1995.

buildup.text: Leeson was a derivatives trader in Singapore, initially profitable and praised by management who skipped oversight.

discovery.text: He hid losses in a secret account numbered 88888. Instead of reporting errors, he doubled down to recover.

twist.text: The Kobe earthquake crashed the Nikkei, magnifying his positions. Losses hit $1.4 billion—more than the bank's capital.

climax.text: Barings collapsed overnight—the oldest merchant bank in Britain, wiped out by one unchecked trader's deception.

punchline.text: No controls meant one man could sink a 233-year institution.

quiz.question: What fundamental failure allowed Leeson to destroy Barings Bank?
options: Lack of oversight and risk controls on a single trader
